product: Genie Code scheduled tasks will soon be available by default for workspaces…
tagline: Genie Code scheduled tasks will be available by default for workspaces with the compliance security profile enabled in October 2026.
what_it_does: Genie Code scheduled tasks will be available by default for workspaces with the compliance security profile enabled in October 2026. You can schedule Genie Code to run a prompt on a recurring schedule. Each run executes your prompt as a full Genie Code session and produces a continuable Genie chat with the results, so you can turn recurring analysis and other work into an unattended background task.
